tokyo_khao.price_note: Course and pairing prices are from the restaurant's own site (tax included, 10% service charge extra). Drink prices are read off the printed card photographed on 2026-03-18. Michelin one star and Gault&Millau 3 toques; the ~8-plate omakase is the only way to eat here and the composition rotates with the season — the plates listed are one dated seating, not a standing menu. Reviewers report ¥30,000–40,000 per person all-in with drinks. Prices approximate — may change.
